    data = fresh_rows(golden_rows)
    for module in [filter_dead_links, filter_duplicates, resolve_location, resolve_title, resolve_company]:

    passed_ids = {r["job_id"] for r in data}
    expected_ids = yes_ids
    missed = expected_ids - passed_ids
    assert not missed, (
        f"YES jobs lost in full normalization pipeline: {sorted(missed)}\n"

    )

"""Collect location strings and tag remote hints; drop jobs provably outside the profile country."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import time

from v2.shared.observability.sli_observe import passed, reject, sli_observe
from v2.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import ExecutionResult

MODULE_NAME = "job_matcher__normalise_location"
MODULE_TYPE = "filter"
REJECTION_REASONS = {"LOCATION_NOT_IN_PROFILE"}
ERROR_REASONS: set[str] = set()
WARNING_REASONS: set[str] = set()

_PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+\s+location", re.IGNORECASE)
_REMOTE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(remote|home.based|work from home|wfh|home based)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
_NON_LATIN_RE = re.compile(r"[　-鿿가-힯Ѐ-ӿ]")  # CJK / Korean / Cyrillic

# Ordered: profile countries first so they short-circuit before non-profile ones.
_COUNTRY_PATTERNS: list[tuple[str, re.Pattern]] = [
    ("United Kingdom", re.compile(
        r"\b(United Kingdom|UK|U\.K\.|England|Scotland|Wales|Great Britain|Northern Ireland|GB)\b",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )),
    ("Ireland", re.compile(r"\b(Ireland|Dublin|Cork|Galway)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("United States", re.compile(
        r"\b(United States|USA|U\.S\.A\.|New York|California|Texas|Florida|Illinois)\b",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )),
    ("Germany", re.compile(r"\b(Germany|Deutschland|Berlin|Munich|Frankfurt|Hamburg)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("France", re.compile(r"\b(France|Paris|Lyon|Marseille)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Japan", re.compile(r"\b(Japan|Tokyo|Osaka|Kyoto)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Australia", re.compile(r"\b(Australia|Sydney|Melbourne|Brisbane|Perth)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Canada", re.compile(r"\b(Canada|Toronto|Vancouver|Montreal|Ottawa)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("India", re.compile(r"\b(India|Mumbai|Delhi|Bangalore|Chennai|Hyderabad)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Netherlands", re.compile(r"\b(Netherlands|Holland|Amsterdam|Rotterdam)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Sweden", re.compile(r"\b(Sweden|Stockholm|Gothenburg)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Poland", re.compile(r"\b(Poland|Warsaw|Krakow)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Spain", re.compile(r"\b(Spain|Madrid|Barcelona)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Italy", re.compile(r"\b(Italy|Rome|Milan|Naples)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("Singapore", re.compile(r"\bSingapore\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("UAE", re.compile(r"\b(UAE|Dubai|Abu Dhabi|United Arab Emirates)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
    ("China", re.compile(r"\b(China|Beijing|Shanghai|Shenzhen|Guangzhou)\b", re.IGNORECASE)),
]


def _collect_location_strings(row: dict) -> list[str]:
    strings: list[str] = []
    page = row.get("page") or {}
    sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}

    for loc in sj.get("locations") or []:
        if loc and str(loc).strip():
            strings.append(str(loc).strip())

    sj_loc = (sj.get("location") or "").strip()
    if sj_loc:
        strings.append(sj_loc)
    for loc in sj.get("additional_locations") or []:
        if loc and str(loc).strip():
            strings.append(str(loc).strip())

    scraped = (row.get("location") or "").strip()
    if scraped and not _PLACEHOLDER_RE.match(scraped):
        strings.append(scraped)

    return strings


def _is_provably_outside_profile(
    strings: list[str], page_text: str, profile_countries: frozenset[str]
) -> bool:
    """True only when all available signals confidently point to a non-profile country.

    Returns False (keep the job) when the country is ambiguous or unknown — the
    agent stage is better placed to make the precise call.
    """
    combined = " ".join(strings)

    if _NON_LATIN_RE.search(combined):
        return True

    for country, pattern in _COUNTRY_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.search(combined):
            return country not in profile_countries

    # Fallback: scan page.text for a country signal.
    if page_text:
        if _NON_LATIN_RE.search(page_text):
            return True
        for country, pattern in _COUNTRY_PATTERNS:
            if pattern.search(page_text):
                return country not in profile_countries

    return False  # ambiguous — keep


def main(context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]) -> ExecutionResult:
    trace_id: str = context.get("trace_id")
    start_time = time.time()

    profile_countries = frozenset(
        (loc.get("country") or "").strip()
        for loc in context["profile"].get("locations") or []
        if loc.get("country")
    )
    has_remote_profile = any(
        loc.get("type") == "remote" for loc in context["profile"].get("locations") or []
    )

    for row in prev_data:
        page = row.get("page") or {}
        strings = _collect_location_strings(row)
        row["location_strings"] = strings

        is_remote = any(_REMOTE_RE.search(s) for s in strings)
        row["is_remote_hint"] = is_remote

        if is_remote and has_remote_profile:
            continue

        if _is_provably_outside_profile(strings, page.get("text") or "", profile_countries):
            reject(row, "LOCATION_NOT_IN_PROFILE")

    sli_observe(prev_data, MODULE_NAME, start_time, trace_id)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=trace_id,
        script_span_id=f"{MODULE_NAME}_{trace_id}",
        data=passed(prev_data),
        artifacts={},
        metrics={},
    )
